ModMetaData.name: Folding Skateboard Renew - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Folding Skateboard Renew, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
The scenarios prepare a clear yard on the Pickle fixture, give a colonist a folding skateboard, put the colonist on floors that are and are not skateable, and read what the mod does: the pick-up entry of the right-click menu and its three refusals, the Shredder trait and the speed it gives, the fast walker trait put away and given back across a save and a reload, and what happens when a rider leaves the map. The pictures the mod exists to produce, the board drawn under a rider and folded on a back, are captures a person looks at.
The mod under test needs no DLC and this companion declares none: the fixture is Pickle's own test-colony.
